project: Black History Heroes: Hall of Legends
publication_note: Working gallery portraits for interface installation, NOT authenticated historical likenesses. For the 21 added African leaders, outer lettered areas were cropped; full headgear and historical visual interpretations need later approval. No machine-generated corrections to historical faces were used.
sources_disclaimer: All images are stylized artistic interpretations and are not necessarily historic likenesses; original source artwork attribution and usage rights require publisher confirmation.
